document.name: South Bronx United Clubhouse Soccer Classes
document.shortDescription: South Bronx United offers one-hour weekend indoor soccer skill-building classes for Bronx kids and teens ages 5-15 at its River Avenue clubhouse.
document.longDescription:
South Bronx United's official registration page lists Clubhouse Soccer Classes and 3v3 League - Indoor for ages 5-15. The page says families can sign up children born in 2009-2021 (U6-U15) for as many individual weekend skill-building classes as they want, and states that each class lasts one hour.

The same official site publishes South Bronx United at 814 River Avenue in the Bronx with contact email info@southbronxunited.org and phone (718) 404-9281. Because the registration page does not publish a single fixed per-class price or a detailed repeating weekend timetable on the public-facing page reviewed here, this listing keeps pricePerClass at 0 and stores the recurring weekend structure conservatively.

Sources: https://southbronxunited.org/register https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/601ad865cf01393aa95bf49b/1614564904592-5FB307KUJFMEWQ66XSRW/03212019-0738.jpg?format=1500w
